thread:
irma_cs: Convoy onboarding blocked on parallel warmup. Their test harness spins 220 headless browsers and were seeing 429 spikes and a handful of 401s. Renewal touchpoint next week, can we triage?

convoy_infra: Repro: start 220 workers, each calls /session/ephemeral then /v1/preflight immediately. Fail rate ~28% 429, ~3% 401. Token create calls themselves succeed if retried.

tony_sdk: Which SDK & version? Any custom retry hooks?

convoy_infra: web-sdk@0.20.0, stock session flow. Tests are isolated containers so no shared memory across workers.

zara_eng: Likely thundering herd when all workers both create tokens and hit preflight simultaneously. Quick options: 1) short in-process token lease (2-4s TTL) to coalesce session creation; 2) randomized startup splay 0-400ms; 3) run warmup from a single server actor rather than many browsers.

irma_cs: Can you give a tiny snippet we can paste into their CI?

tony_sdk: Sure, small pattern we've shared before:```js// per-container lease (Node)let lease=null;async function leaseToken(){ if(lease && Date.now()<lease.exp) return lease.token; const r=await fetch('/session/ephemeral'); const token=await r.text(); lease={token,exp:Date.now()+3000}; return token; }async function preflight(){ const t=await leaseToken(); await fetch('/v1/preflight',{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${t}`}}); }```This reduces token fanout. Also add: setTimeout(start, Math.random()*350) on each worker.

infra-bot: DEPLOY: preflight-rate-limit rolled (rule preflight-window-5s) at 2026-03-17T11:08Z.

zara_eng: That deploy narrowed the burst window. Short-term, we can also request a temporary quota bump for Convoy while they complete onboarding. Long-term SDK idea: expose session_coalesce: true so SDK automatically reuses session tokens per-origin for N ms. We'll file RFC.

convoy_infra: We tried lease+350ms splay. Re-ran 220 workers: 429s down to ~6%, 401s eliminated. Good improvement.

irma_cs: Great. For hand-off: I'll open RevOps ticket for a short quota bump and send the snippet. Anything else to add to the runbook?

zara_eng: Two more checks: 1) verify CI containers have NTP synced; we saw a 401 once from an 8s clock skew; 2) if they route through an internal test proxy, ensure it preserves Authorization + Origin headers and uses keep-alive. Proxy connection churn can increase upstream load.

convoy_infra: Confirmed: one 401 correlated with a container clock 7s fast. NTP sync fixed it. Proxy preserves headers and runs keep-alive.

tony_sdk: If they want an immediate alternative, run server-side warmup: spawn one helper service to sequentially exercise preflight for many origins, which spreads load and avoids origin bursts from many isolated processes.

zara_eng: Engineering follow-up: consider adding a small burst buffer at preflight ingress (200-500ms) to absorb cold-start warmups. Also adding a metric for origin preflight burst rate would help surface these onboarding patterns earlier.

irma_cs: I'll capture the mitigation steps and checklist items (lease snippet, jitter, NTP, proxy keep-alive) and share with Convoy + RevOps. Tagging product for SDK session_coalesce RFC.

convoy_infra: Thanks team we'll finish the full warmup overnight and report back in the morning. Appreciated!
